build_rrpn_proposal_generator: build a rotated region proposal network using RRPN class registered in PROPOSAL_GENERATOR_REGISTRY
create_top_rrpn_proposals: create top rotated RPN proposals by selecting pre_nms_topk and applying batched NMS with rotated boxes
label_and_sample_anchors: label and sample rotated anchors by computing pairwise IoU with ground truth boxes and subsampling labels
predict_rrpn_proposals: predict rotated region proposals by decoding anchor deltas and selecting top scoring proposals after NMS
review_rrpn_from_config: review the RRPN from_config method to configure Box2BoxTransformRotated with custom bbox regression weights
